line: Crowley's Five of Cups is the card for the first decan of Scorpio, with Mars as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Scorpio.

quotes.quote: the Five of Cups is called Disappointment
The attribution is also to Mars in Scorpio, which is his own house

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card is ruled by Geburah in the suit of Water.
